books.title: Suicide Terrorism
books.description: A comprehensive cross-cultural analysis of suicide terrorism, tracing its emergence in Lebanon, Israel, Sri Lanka, Turkey, Chechnya, Iraq, and Al-Qaeda's global jihad.

books.title: The Israeli Secret Services and the Struggle Against Terrorism
books.description: Examines Israel's counterterrorism strategies from 1948 onward, arguing that defensive measures have proven more effective than offensive operations and targeted killings.
books.coverAlt: Cover of The Israeli Secret Services and the Struggle Against Terrorism

books.title: Jewish Terrorism in Israel
books.description: Explores how religious terrorism emerges from totalistic communities, spanning from the ancient sicarii to the assassination of Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin.
books.coverAlt: Cover of Jewish Terrorism in Israel

books.title: The Triumph of Israel's Radical Right
books.description: Documents the radical right's ascendance in Israeli politics and its institutional networks, tracing the movement from fringe ideology to mainstream governance.
books.coverAlt: Cover of The Triumph of Israel's Radical Right

publications.title: Territorial Control and the Militarization of Violent Non-State Actors: Transformation, Opportunities, and Vulnerabilities
publications.summary: Examines how territorial control changes the structure, capabilities, and weaknesses of violent non-state actors.

publications.title: The Munich Massacre and the Proliferation of Counter-Terrorism Special Operation Forces
publications.summary: Connects the Munich massacre to the international spread of specialized counter-terrorism units and doctrine.

publications.title: Managing High-Volume Digital Sources in Political Research with Emerging Technologies
publications.authors: Jonathan Grossman, Orel B. Amano, and Ami Pedahzur
publications.label: Unpublished Working Paper
publications.summary: A pre-ChatGPT working paper on using personal knowledge management systems to organize high-volume digital sources without losing context, source criticism, or human interpretation.

publications.title: Reconstructing the Theater of Terror
publications.authors: Matthew Sweeney, Arie Perliger, and Ami Pedahzur
publications.summary: Investigates the operational theater of terrorism and how spatial and organizational factors shape violent campaigns.

publications.title: Can We Do Better? Replication and Online Appendices in Political Science
publications.summary: Assesses replication practices and the quality of online appendices in political science research.

publications.title: Political Science and Big Data: Why We Need Unstructured Big Data and How to Use It
publications.summary: Argues for the use of unstructured big data in political science and outlines practical strategies for analysis.

publications.title: Counter-Cultures, Group Dynamics and Religious Terrorism
publications.summary: Explores the interaction between group dynamics, counter-cultures, and the emergence of religious terrorism.

publications.title: Social Network Analysis in the Study of Terrorism and Political Violence
publications.summary: Shows how social network analysis can reveal structure, diffusion, and hierarchy in violent organizations.

publications.title: The Changing Nature of Suicide Attacks: A Social Network Perspective
publications.summary: Uses a social network perspective to explain changes in suicide attack organization and execution.
